title: 4 Supreme Court Rulings Explained: Vote, Money, Guns & Law (2026 Election)【PZRT2026-S4】
description: What happens when classic superheroes step off the screen and bring the U.S. Supreme Court before a public jury? In this dramatic presentation, "The UnSupreme Court: The People vs. The Supreme Court," Supermench, Ms. Democracy, Eagle Eye, American Spirit, and legal scholars assemble on the courthouse steps to break down four critical decisions impacting the American public.
